groups.defect: Parallel index initialization races on the captured err variable and the unsynchronized totalBatchesIndexed counter.
groups.rationale: Both report exactly the same shared-variable races in searchSupport.init, exposed by removing the BuildIndex-wide lock, and propose the same fixes.

groups.defect: Concurrent builds for the same resource key are not deduplicated, allowing competing indexes, cache overwrites, lost writes, leaked indexes, and file-directory conflicts.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same unchecked concurrent build sequence and final cache overwrite. The additional leak consequence describes the same defect; per-key build deduplication resolves both reports.
